home.heroSubtitle: Mountains, lakes and nomadic culture with a local team. North from Bishkek, south from Osh. Groups of 2–6.
home.northDesc: Ala-Archa, Issyk-Kul, Song-Kul, canyons — departure from Bishkek
home.southDesc: Osh, Arslanbob, Sary-Chelek — another face of the country
home.why1Desc: Program, timing and difficulty written in advance. Not a “see everything at once” template.
home.why2Desc: 4,000+ visas and 15+ high-level events. A contract and a clear invoice.
home.why3Desc: Local guides and drivers. Small groups — we listen and adjust the pace.
home.why4Desc: WhatsApp, Telegram and phone before, during and after the trip.
